findings.description: keyboardTextError checks the 4096 cap against the RAW value (keyboardText.value.length) while onSubmit emits the TRIMMED text (keyboardText.value.trim() at line 963/984). The backend requireKeyboardText validates the received (already-trimmed) value's length. So a message of exactly 4096 visible chars with trailing whitespace (raw >4096) is over-blocked client-side even though the trimmed payload the backend receives would pass. This is over-strictness only (never a 422 mismatch / never under-blocks), on a pathological edge, and it mirrors the composer's TEXT_WARN_LIMIT idiom — so it is consistent with the established form convention. The blank check on line 631 correctly uses the trimmed value.
findings.recommendation: Optional: check text.length (the trimmed value already computed on line 631) against KEYBOARD_TEXT_MAX so the form's accept/reject boundary matches the backend's post-trim validation exactly. Leave as-is if matching the composer's raw-length warn idiom is the deliberate convention.

summary: Task 2 is high quality and production-ready. The TS type mirrors (StepType union, KeyboardButton/KeyboardRow, five nullable FunnelStep fields) match the tech-spec Data Models frontend block exactly. The SET_KEYBOARD/CLEAR_KEYBOARD form blocks follow the existing composer/MENU local-reactive-array + *Touched hand-validation idiom faithfully (uid-keyed rows, cap-guarded mutators, add controls disabled at caps, errors gated on keyboardTouched). Validation mirrors backend FunnelService.validateSetKeyboard/validateClearKeyboard byte-for-byte: non-blank text, 1..10 rows, 1..4 buttons/row, button text non-blank and length cap, and Set-based case-sensitive duplicate detection on TRIMMED texts (verified against the now-landed backend Task 1). The default-clobbering ?? bug is correctly avoided — isPersistent/oneTimeKeyboard are seeded via type-guarded checks so a stored explicit false/true survives (verified by the edit-seed test). CLEAR_KEYBOARD emits ONLY text+parseMode (+ id/next), never keyboardRows/isPersistent/oneTimeKeyboard, matching the backend's symmetric strict rejection. The keyword hint mirrors backend containsAnyKeyword precisely (lowercased contains-match over active keyword funnels, null-keywords and empty-keyword guarded) and is advisory-only — never gates onSubmit (covered by a dedicated test). Stale state from a switched type cannot block submit (keyboardValid short-circuits to text-only for CLEAR; rows validated only for SET). Both checkbox defaults (persistent ON, one-time OFF), no resize_keyboard control, all text via {{ }} interpolation (no v-html). i18n keys are at full uk/en parity (24 additions each, identical key sets, summary.setKeyboard/clearKeyboard added). The spec covers the full TDD Anchor list plus extras (inactive/non-keyword funnel hint, hint-never-blocks). One minor over-strictness on the text-length boundary (raw vs trimmed) — never causes a 422, only over-blocks a pathological trailing-whitespace edge, and is consistent with the composer idiom. No blocking or major issues.
